name: Bezdarnoye leto
source:
One day, on New Year's Eve, a [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bratishkinoff]Bratishkin[/url]'s subscriber remembers an [url=/v3126]Everlasting Summer[/url] mod featuring the 89 Squad. The guy isn't sure if this mod was ever finished or abandoned, but he decides to search for it in the Steam Workshop. Due to a long loading screen, the protagonist falls asleep, after which unpredictable things begin to happen in his life. The sub will have to meet the guys from the 89 Squad and try to befriend them.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2697126181]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，在除夕夜，一位 [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bratishkinoff]Bratishkin[/url] 的订阅者记得一个以89 Squad为特色的 [url=/v3126]Everternity Summer[/url] mod。这家伙不确定这个模组是否已经完成或被放弃，但他决定在Steam创意工坊中搜索它。由于加载时间过长，主角睡着了，之后他的生活开始发生不可预测的事情。替补队员必须与89小队的人见面并尝试与他们成为朋友。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2697126181]Steam[/url]]
